title: SA/98/2004 of BALWANT Vs JAGDISH PRASAD and ANOTHER

paras.text:
Delay Cond. App. 6408 / 09
Substitution App. 6409 / 09
Setting Aside Abat 6410 / 09
Compromise App. 10875 / 09
In
S.A. No. 98 of 2004
Hon. Prafulla C. Pant, J.
 Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Lok Pal Singh,
Advocate present for the appellant.
This is Delay Condonation Application No. 6408 of 2009, for
condoning the delay in moving the substitution application.
Heard.
The application is allowed. Delay is condoned in filing the
substitution application.
Also, heard on Substitution Application No. 6409 of 2009, for
substitution of legal representatives of the deceased respondent No. 2/1
Kalwati.
The application is supported by affidavit. The application is allowed.
Substitution be incorporated in the memorandum of appeal during the
course of the day.
Substitution is incorporated.
Also, Setting Aside Abatement Application No. 6410 of 2009 stands
allowed.
There is a Compromise Application filed on behalf of the parties,
which is numbered as 10875 of 2009, whereby the parties to the appeal have
entered into compromise in this case. The compromise is supported by
affidavit. As per the terms of the compromise plaintiff / respondent No. 1
shall be the exclusive owner of the property No. 2. However, he will have
no entitlement in respect of property No. 1.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties, this appeal is disposed of
and decreed in terms of the compromise / affidavit filed with the
Compromise Application No. 10875 of 2009, which shall form part of the
decree of this appeal. (Compromise Application No. 10875 of 2009 stands
disposed of).
(P.C. P., J.)
 15.12.2009
HN
